title: Capture a coherent engineering input selection
description: Capture the explicitly selected authoritative model and permitted supporting content with a complete membership and content identity for subsequent interpretation and projection.
inputs: Selected project, immutable state/export and explicit model/supporting-content membership.
Requested profile identity and access context.
outputs: Captured content and member digests with selected-state identity.
Explicit missing, changed, unsafe or unsupported selection outcomes.
behavior: Admit an immutable selected state or a declared immutable export; a live mutable directory without an established stable selection is rejected rather than assumed coherent.
Collect only profile-declared members and explicitly selected supporting rationale; never recursively export unrelated workspace or operational history.
Bind file membership, bytes and profile identity to the capture; detect additions, removals and content drift against the declared basis.
Return captured content without changing authoritative input or claiming baseline retention.

failure_behavior.condition: The selection is mutable, changed, incomplete or unsafe.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the affected scope and no coherent-input success.
Preserve its explicit limitation separately from required-input validity.

sources.basis: System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
